## Precision Recall 

All the validations, including GFA (only with names) and FA (with location) can be found in `matrix.py` script.

### Validation for Simulated GFA
```{bash}
# uv run eris -i ../data/EC958_complete_genome.fasta -d ../data/IS_n.mmi -o ../progress/result/dimas_fa -m collapse --merge-synonyms
```

Validation after merging with min identity = 0.75
```{python}
import matrix as mt
import pandas as pd

# The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only
gt = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_CHROMOSOME, exclude=["ISSen10"])
gfa = mt.read_report("../result/dimas_gfa/dimas_gfa_report.tsv")

summaries = []
for count_copies in (True, False):
    summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=count_copies)
    summaries.append(summary)

display(pd.DataFrame(summaries))

# IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted)
_, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt, gfa, count_copies=True)
detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)]

```

### Validation for Complete genome GFA (realfastq)

```{python}
# The simulated GFA was assembled from the chromosome only
gt_comp = mt.read_truth(mt.GT_COMPLETE, exclude=["ISSen10"])
gfa_comp = mt.read_report("../result/realfastq/realfastq_report.tsv")

summaries = []
for count_copies in (True, False):
    summary, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt_comp, gfa_comp, count_copies=count_copies)
    summaries.append(summary)

display(pd.DataFrame(summaries))

# IS where eris and the truth disagree (copies counted)
_, detail = mt.precision_recall_gfa(gt_comp, gfa_comp, count_copies=True)
detail[(detail["FP"] > 0) | (detail["FN"] > 0)]

```

### Validation for Complete genome 


# Summary of IS to investigate

## ISec8 & IS629
- Expected to be only 1 copy, but found 2 copies in the complete genome assembly. 
- The problem might arise from this code:

`if self.topology_engine is not None and getattr(self.topology_engine, 'mode', 'variant') == 'collapse':
    contig_depth = self.genome.contig_depths.get(contig, 1.0)
    metric_val = float(max(1, round(contig_depth / self.topology_engine.median_depth)))`

```{python}
read_gfa = pd.read_csv("../result/dimas_fix_sim/dimas_fix_sim_report.tsv", sep="\t")

print(read_gfa[read_gfa["target"].str.endswith("_stitched")][["target", "copy_number"]])

print("Any IS that was stitched with copy number == 1:")
print(read_gfa[
    read_gfa["target"].str.endswith("stitched") &
    (read_gfa["copy_number"] == 1)
][["target", "copy_number"]])
```

There are no stitched IS that has 1 copy.

```{python}
# Length and depth of every contig in the stitched path of ISEc8 and ISEc23.
# eris copy number = round(max depth on the path / median depth of all contigs)
from eris.io import GenomeAssembly

genome = GenomeAssembly.from_file(str(mt.GFA))
median_depth = pd.Series(genome.contig_depths).median()
print(f"Median depth of all contigs: {median_depth:.1f}")

for is_name in ["ISEc8", "ISEc23", "IS629"]:
    # match synonyms too (IS629 is reported as IS3411 here); stitched locus first
    loci = read_gfa[read_gfa["target"].map(lambda t: mt.is_group(mt.is_name(t))) == mt.is_group(is_name)]
    locus = loci.sort_values("target", key=lambda t: ~t.str.endswith("_stitched")).iloc[0]
    path = pd.DataFrame({"Contig": locus["locus_contig"].split("|")})
    path["Length"] = path["Contig"].map(lambda c: len(genome[c]))
    path["Depth"] = path["Contig"].map(genome.contig_depths).round(1)
    path["Depth / median"] = (path["Depth"] / median_depth).round(2)
    path[""] = ""
    path.loc[path["Depth"].idxmax(), ""] = "← max"

    print(f"\n{is_name}: eris copy number = {locus['copy_number']:.0f}")
    display(path)
```

**This is for the fastq:**
```{python}
# Length and depth of every contig in the stitched path of ISEc8 and ISEc23.
# eris copy number = round(max depth on the path / median depth of all contigs)
from eris.io import GenomeAssembly

read_fastq = pd.read_csv("../result/realfastq/realfastq_report.tsv", sep="\t")
genome = GenomeAssembly.from_file(str(mt.GFA_FASTQ))
median_depth = pd.Series(genome.contig_depths).median()
print(f"Median depth of all contigs: {median_depth:.1f}")

for is_name in ["ISEc8", "ISEc23", "IS629", "IS15DI"]:  # IS15DI is on the plasmid, so only here
    # match synonyms too (IS629 is reported as IS3411 here); stitched locus first
    loci = read_fastq[read_fastq["target"].map(lambda t: mt.is_group(mt.is_name(t))) == mt.is_group(is_name)]
    locus = loci.sort_values("target", key=lambda t: ~t.str.endswith("_stitched")).iloc[0]
    path = pd.DataFrame({"Contig": locus["locus_contig"].split("|")})
    path["Length"] = path["Contig"].map(lambda c: len(genome[c]))
    path["Depth"] = path["Contig"].map(genome.contig_depths).round(1)
    path["Depth / median"] = (path["Depth"] / median_depth).round(2)
    path[""] = ""
    path.loc[path["Depth"].idxmax(), ""] = "← max"

    print(f"\n{is_name}: eris copy number = {locus['copy_number']:.0f}")
    display(path)
```
